items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: He said, "Well, you stay out to my room. Take my room."

ctx.x: And -- because he told me, you know, that they bought him a bass, you know, and then he told me, he says, "Hey, Mack, what are you doing in town?" I says, "Well, I'm on my way to Omaha. The gig played out down here in Kansas. I got an uncle in Omaha and I'm going to go up there and see what's happening." He said, "No, you don't want to go no further. You stay right here in Kansas City." I said, "Man, I don't have no money." He said, "Well, you stay out to my room. Take my room."
